source.author: cic
source.text: Praeclare enim Ennius: Quém metuunt, odérunt; quem quisque ódit, periisse éxpetit.
source.text_original: Praeclare enim Ennius:  Quém metuunt, odérunt; quem quisque ódit, periisse éxpetit.
source.text_english: For Ennius put it excellently: whom they fear, they hate; whom each person hates, he longs to see destroyed.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: antiqua sententia est: quem metuit quis, odit; quem odit, perisse cupit.
reuse.text_original: antiqua sententia est: quem metuit quis, odit; quem odit, perisse cupit.
reuse.text_english: An old saying is this: whom someone fears, he hates; whom he hates, he wishes to have perished.
